name: crypto-futures-basis-tracker
title: Crypto Futures vs Spot: Premium by Expiry and Annual Yield
description: Keyless OKX dated futures data: how far above or below the spot index each expiry trades, converted into an annual percentage yield, for BTC, ETH, SOL and gold. Includes the full term structure, a per coin summary with the curve shape, and the rate implied between consecutive expiries. Pay per row.
